verdict.rationale: Signifyd's docs confirm the core Guaranteed Fraud Protection model — orders sent to Signifyd receive a guarantee decision, chargebacks are recorded against orders, and guarantees can be cancelled with prorated credit on refunds — matching a liability-shift/chargeback reimbursement offering. missing for 10: explicit published coverage terms/limits and reimbursement process details, and independent third-party confirmation of payout mechanics beyond vendor docs/pricing page.
